brief: Smoke-test this universe's book pipeline end to end with a MINIMAL test book: a front cover, exactly ONE interior spread, and a closing plate. Rules: (1) reuse existing LOCKED entities and settings only, no new entities, no reference shoots; (2) at most 3 image generation calls total; (3) use the universe's own book chain and conventions, including the pre-render gate and read-backs; (4) title the book "The Smoke Test"; (5) do NOT publish anywhere, do NOT narrate audio, stop after the local render passes its checks; (6) finish with a plain report of every artifact path you created. Keep it cheap and honest: this run exists to prove the flow, not to make a keeper.
